hypothesis: Jointly estimate physical effects, nested geographic random intercepts, and region-specific material/age slopes in one penalized multinomial likelihood. No target encoding.
new_vs_failed: Phase2 fitted post-hoc regional intercepts on cross-fitted physical predictions. Phase5 optimizes all physical and geographic coefficients simultaneously and tests varying physical slopes. No posterior proxy repair, KNN, global TE expansions, tree/MLP, loss/threshold/quota search, or probability pooling.
screening: Same historical seed847 holdout; require best new delta > .002, otherwise stop after two fits. Reuse frozen reference screening probabilities.
promotion: Run seed2026 only if seed42 delta > .001 and bootstrap CI lower > 0. Candidate recommendation requires both seeds delta > .001 and CI lower > 0.
compute: Two small sparse convex models. Reuse prior reference inner scores/outer probabilities after verifying row hashes and split protocol; do not retrain failed old models. No hyperparameter sweep.
history: Sequential hypotheses on historically used data. Proper fold isolation does not erase historical selection exposure. No actual new Kaggle score is measured.
